3	import java.math.BigDecimal;
4	import java.util.List;
5	import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
6	import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
7	
8	/**
9	 * Data access for {@link Invoice}. A Spring Data bean, injected into the OfficeFloor logic classes
10	 * (Spring beans are exposed to OfficeFloor by the rest-spring-boot starter).
11	 */
12	public interface InvoiceRepository extends JpaRepository<Invoice, Long> {
13	
14	    /** Every invoice for one project, oldest id first — the shape a project's list renders. */
15	    List<Invoice> findByProjectIdOrderByIdAsc(Long projectId);
16	
17	    /**
18	     * Every invoice across all projects with the NAME of the project it belongs to, oldest id
19	     * first — the shape the one all-invoices list renders.
20	     */
21	    @Query("SELECT new net.officefloor.hq.app.InvoiceView(i.id, i.projectId, p.name, i.amount, "
22	            + "i.status) FROM Invoice i, Project p WHERE i.projectId = p.id ORDER BY i.id ASC")
23	    List<InvoiceView> findAllViews();
24	
25	    /**
26	     * Total amount still owed: the sum of every SENT-but-not-yet-paid invoice's amount across all
27	     * projects. Only invoices actually sent to the client count — DRAFT invoices are excluded
28	     * (they have not been billed yet) and PAID invoices are settled. COALESCE keeps it 0 (never
29	     * null) when nothing is outstanding — the dashboard's headline figure.
30	     */
31	    @Query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.amount), 0) FROM Invoice i WHERE i.status = 'SENT'")
32	    BigDecimal sumOutstanding();
33	}

-- Invoices: the third domain table. An invoice has a monetary amount and belongs to a project
-- (project_id FK). GENERATED BY DEFAULT (not ALWAYS) so the /__test__ seed path can insert
-- explicit fixture ids.
CREATE TABLE invoices (
    id         BIGINT        GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id BIGINT        NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    amount     DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL
);

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# The agent's test loop (DESIGN.md §15): build, start the whole app, run ONLY the specs currently
# present in e2e/specs (the agent sees only its own checkpoint's spec — blind), then stop.
# PINNED — do not edit. Contract: BASE_CHECKLIST.md §C, §D.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

export PORT="${PORT:-3000}"
export BASE_URL="http://localhost:${PORT}"
# Known audit file, shared by the app (bin/start) and the specs (support/audit.ts). Absolute.
export AUDIT_FILE="${AUDIT_FILE:-$PWD/.run/audit.log}"

bin/build
bin/start
cleanup() { bin/stop || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT

# Wait for readiness (Actuator health), then run the Playwright specs against BASE_URL.
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if curl -fsS "${BASE_URL}/actuator/health" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done

# Install deps + the Chromium browser (both cached after first run), then run the specs.
( cd e2e && npm ci --silent && npx --yes playwright install chromium && npx playwright test )

Both tests pass. The change is complete. Here's a summary of what I implemented as a full-stack, additive change.

## What changed

An invoice's amount is now the sum of its **line items** (description, quantity, price each) rather than a single typed figure — and the total is worked out automatically.

**Database** (`src/main/resources/db/migration/V11__invoice_line_items.sql`)
- New `invoice_line_items` table (`id`, `invoice_id` FK, `description`, `qty`, `unit_price`), following the `GENERATED BY DEFAULT` convention so the seed path can supply explicit fixture ids.

**Server** (OfficeFloor + Spring)
- `LineItem` entity + `LineItemRepository` (lines for an invoice, oldest first).
- `GET /api/invoices/{id}/lineitems` (`InvoiceLineItemsGet`) and `POST /api/invoices/{id}/lineitems` (`InvoiceLineItemsPost` + `NewLineItem`), each a new logic class + YAML file under `rest/api/`. The POST validates the line, saves it, and keeps the invoice's stored `amount` in step (= Σ qty × unitPrice) so every existing view that reads `amount` stays correct.
- `TestSupportController`: added `invoice_line_items` to the reset table list (child-first) and replaced the flat invoice seed with `seedInvoices`, which seeds each invoice's nested `lineItems` and derives the invoice amount from them (still accepting an explicit `amount` for line-less invoices).

**Front-end** (all new files)
- `features/lineitems/` — `queries.ts`, `LineItemsTable.tsx` (renders `invoice-lineitems-table`, `lineitem-row-<id>` with description/qty/unit-price/amount cells, and the derived `invoice-amount` total), `LineItemForm.tsx` (`lineitem-form-*` inputs + submit, invalidating `['lineitems', invoiceId]`).
- `routes/invoice.$invoiceId.tsx` — the invoice detail page (a standalone route so only the invoice's own detail renders, keeping `invoice-amount` unique on the page).
- `features/invoices/open.slot.tsx` — an `invoice-open-<id>` link filling the existing `InvoiceRow` slot, no existing file edited.

No pinned scaffolding or the test spec was touched. Frontend `typecheck` passes and both `bin/e2e` tests are green.
